skill.summary: Manage end-to-end logistics: track shipments, optimize routes, coordinate carriers, handle warehouses, customs, returns, fleet, and monitor KPIs.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of koompi-logistics skill for end-to-end logistics and supply chain operations.

- Offers comprehensive features including shipment tracking, warehouse management, route optimization, carrier coordination, order fulfillment, customs documentation, fleet management, reverse logistics, and KPI monitoring.
- Provides detailed workflows for heartbeat monitoring, shipment status checks, warehouse inventory, carrier management, order fulfillment, and delivery scheduling.
- Includes best practices and protocols for exception handling, performance scorecards, and operational optimization.
- Supports multi-warehouse networks, route planning, and last-mile delivery coordination.
